column1: # Travel costs for ordering a run, in game ticks (0.6 s). Rough is fine: they only decide the order.
#   arrive <location> <ticks>    cost of reaching the location from anywhere: its teleport plus the walk.
#   link <a> <b> <ticks>         a cheaper way between two locations (a walk, a spirit tree hop). Works both ways.
# A leg costs the cheaper of its link (if there is one) and the destination's arrive cost.
# The arrive costs come from timed runs (2026-10-17/18): the median travel time to each location, in ticks.
# Locations not timed then (or timed once on a detour) keep their hand-tuned guess.
# Once you've done a leg twice, the plugin plans with your own times instead (TravelLog, LearnedCosts).
# Spirit tree hops (walk to the tree, travel, walk to the patch).
